title: Catalyst status reply
description: The one-reply shape a status answer follows. Every line names a ticket identifier; nothing in it is a guess. Fill it from scripts/snapshot.mjs and scripts/explain.mjs, then render it as prose in this order.

source.description: Where the facts came from, in one clause: the API, or the replica with its cursor and heartbeat age. Copy the snapshot's source line; never omit it when the replica was stale.

scope.description: The team key or project the reply covers, when the human asked about one.

inFlight.description: Tickets a phase is running on right now, or that sit mid-ladder with a live lease. One entry per ticket.

blocked.description: Tickets nothing is offered for, each with the reason in the human's words and who or what releases it.

onWhom.description: The human, a named role, the cloud itself, or a clock — never blank.

waitingOnHuman.description: Open asks, ranked by what each holds. Taken from snapshot.waitingOnHuman; the what-needs-me skill owns the detail.

closed.description: Tickets that reached the done slot since the window the human asked about (or since the last reply).

next.description: What the queue will pick up next, in queue order, with the phase each will run.

cannotSee.description: Facts your key cannot read (PR labels and reactions; an operator-only park release), named, with where the human can read them (the CLI prints the URL).

summary.description: One clause: what it is and where it stands.

stage.description: The stage name as the contract spells it for this team.

phase.description: The ladder phase running or offered, when known.

age.description: How long it has sat where it is, in human units.
